title.en: What the Automatic transmission outline cannot add to Electric 15 Concrete Pump

description.en: Section titles come from Automatic transmission; the Electric 15 Concrete Pump figures stay the printed ones. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Electric 15 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Motor Power 15 kW; Theoretical Output 8–10 m³/h; Vertical Delivery Height 15–20 m; Horizontal Delivery Distance 60–80 m; Max. Aggregate Size 1–3 cm; Delivery Pipe Diameter 100–125 mm; Dimensions (L×W×H) 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm; Total Weight 450 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 节标题来自《Automatic transmission》，电动15型混凝土泵的数字仍是已印数字。邢台河北品锦机械公布电动15型混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：电机功率15 kW；理论输送量8–10 m³/h；垂直输送高度15–20 m；水平输送距离60–80 m；最大骨料粒径1–3 cm；输送管内径100–125 mm；外形尺寸1900 × 900 × 1200 mm；整机重量450 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
